private_lines.Ayanda: You live alone in a flat in Cape Town and teach at a primary school, spending your days with Grade 3 learners and marking schoolwork at home in the evenings.
private_lines.Sipho: You work as a sommelier at a restaurant in Cape Town, so your days start late and your evenings are spent on the floor during service. You live alone in a flat in the city.
private_lines.Stefan: You work as a chartered accountant in an office in Cape Town, with steady client work during the day and some reports to finish at home in the evenings. You share a house in the city with your partner, and your evenings are usually quiet.

text: Break duty and I've just found a Grade 3 answer that says dinosaurs went extinct because they were too big to fit on the ark 😭
Marking season is a full contact sport
Who's the ark kid
No names 🤐 but she is very sure
Another one wrote "a noun is a person place or thing or a feeling" and then drew the feeling as a cloud
Lol a cloud is honestly a fair reading
Client sent a spreadsheet with 14 tabs at 12:55. Lunch is over now 🙃
14 tabs 😩 someone should be sent to the principal
Just up. Coffee, then service at 5. Nobody here is getting sympathy from me
Home. The spelling test pile is judging me from the table
[photo: a worksheet with "bananna" circled in red and "BANANA" written next to it in capitals]
Still at the laptop. Reports for Thursday. The bananna one is brutal 😂
Going to bed before I start crying into the red pen 📝
Up. Ark kid's mom has requested a meeting 🙈
Meeting is at 14:00. Pray for me
Client just sent a revised tab 7, which apparently changes everything in tabs 2 to 6 🙃
Did it help that the ark kid drew the ark? Asking for the mom
Ok she was lovely actually. Just wants the kid to read Genesis herself 😂
Up. Staff fridge lunch was a sad sandwich. Service at 5, table of 12 tonight
Ayanda that's a good outcome for a mom meeting
Grade 3 parents are a different breed to Grade 3 kids 😅
Reports submitted 19:58 🎉
Going to be useless the rest of the night
Night. Spelling test tomorrow, the bananna family is coming with me to school 📝
Service done. Table of 12 ordered the cheap red with the fish and then asked if it was the good one. It was fine. Feet are dead
Up. Rain on the window. Spelling test bag already packed 📝
Morning. Client wants a call at 8 to talk through tab 7
Call's booked, tab 7 is now "7b". Not sure what happened to 7a
Awake. Feet are still a bit sad
Spelling test done. Half the class got banana right. The other half had opinions 😂
One of them put the extra n in as a decoration
Call finished. 7b is final. Probably 🙃
Meeting-free afternoon 🙏 someone tell me 7b isn't going to become 7c
Can't promise anything
Up. Coffee, then service at 5. Another table of 12, apparently they're all related
[photo: Table Mountain with a cloud sitting on top of it]
Cloud reading confirmed 😂
Tablecloth's on so the mountain's sorted
Partner made dinner, I've closed the laptop. Nothing else is happening tonight 🎉
Bed in 20. Marking done, red pen retired for the night 📝
Night 👍
Service done. Someone ordered the cheapest bottle and then photographed it for their Instagram. Feet are dead again
